actionConfiguration.body:
WITH access AS (
  SELECT public.can_view_donation_financials(mp.member_id) AS allowed
  FROM public.member_profiles mp
  WHERE lower(mp.email) = lower({{ appsmith.user.email }})
    AND mp.status = 'active'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t.deposit_batch_id,
  t.status,
  t.batch_created_at,
  t.batch_updated_at,
  t.deposit_date,
  t.deposit_slip_number,
  t.destination_bank_account,
  t.preparer_id,
  t.preparer_email,
  t.prepared_by,
  t.prepared_at,
  t.verifier_id,
  t.verifier_email,
  t.confirmed_at,
  t.cancelled_at,
  t.cancelled_by,
  t.expected_amount_cents,
  t.actual_amount_cents,
  t.item_count,
  t.item_total_cents,
  s.status AS erp_sync_status,
  s.attempt_count AS erp_sync_attempt_count,
  s.last_attempt_at AS erp_sync_last_attempt_at,
  s.synced_at AS erp_synced_at,
  s.erp_doctype,
  s.erp_name,
  s.last_error AS erp_sync_last_error
FROM public.cash_deposit_batch_tally t
LEFT JOIN public.cash_deposit_erp_sync s
  ON s.deposit_batch_id = t.deposit_batch_id
CROSS JOIN access a
WHERE a.allowed
ORDER BY t.batch_created_at DESC, t.deposit_batch_id;
